Of the verb नाथ् when meaning 'to bless', the object takes the 6th-Case-affix.

Terms: विभक्ति-6

The affix वुन् is applied after all verbs when Benediction is intended.

Terms: वुन्

The affix खच् comes after the verb भू 'to be' when in composition with the case-inflected word आशित 'satisfied by eating' and the sense is that of instrument or condition.

Terms: खच्

The affix ड comes after the verb हन् 'to kill' when the object is in composition with it and when benediction is intended.

Terms: ड

The affixes लिङ् (Benedictive) and लोट् (Imperative) come after a verb by which 'benediction' is intended.

Terms: लिङ् and लोट्

The word आशित meaning 'having eaten' has acute on the first syllable.

Terms: accent
The change which is a अङ्ग (stem) will undergo by the application of any of the rules from this sūtra up to भस्य
, is to be considered as not to have taken effect when we have to apply any other rule of this very section
